author: StarTalk
description:
Would putting data centers in space cool them down? Neil deGrasse Tyson and Chuck Nice break down three ways energy transfers and what to do with them. From convection ovens, to data centers in space, to staying warm on Apollo 13, learn about all the ways heat and energy move.
